title: Hannah Stokes redefines soulful storytelling with a song of strength “Glory”
htmlContent: Hannah Stokes shines brightly with her new single "Glory," an experience filled with deep feelings and soulful sounds. Inspired by music legends like Joni Mitchell, Lianne La Havas, and Aretha Franklin, Hannah creates a timeless sound. Her voice is smooth and strong, guiding listeners through a story of personal strength. The song blends different styles, mixing jazz, folk, and gospel elements. "Glory" is a song for anyone who has fought hard to find their place in the world. The music starts softly and grows into a powerful chorus, matching the uplifting message of the lyrics. The simple production allows Hannah's voice to shine, ensuring every word feels meaningful. https://open.spotify.com/track/0U8iE1VHsvRi4c6CamxUPz?si=NUIR6FyvTAmVcBvuBFlscw There's no overly polished sound, just Hannah's voice sharing a heartfelt story. It's a declaration and a song that shows Hannah Stokes is an artist to watch. She honors her influences while creating a unique space for herself in music. For fans of soul, folk, and great storytelling, this is a song you won't want to miss. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram
